node.title: Multiline replace regexp.
node.author: nikolay
node.doctext: my $q='qqqweqwe asdasdasd zxczxczxc tyutyutyi '; my $a='zxczxczxc'; How do i remove with regexp all the chars of the $q variable content, starting from the beginning of it and down to $a, including $a variable content? -- Something like: $q=~s#[.\n]*$a##; -- if it could work with multiline. (As the content of both variables can change, the regexp uses * instead of +). Thank you.
